children: The Brazilian government has allocated an additional 6.6 billion reais ($1.3 billion) for fuel subsidies, according to an executive order signed by President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva on Wednesday, when a subsidy for gasoline was set to expire.

The measure established that some 5.6 billion reais will be allocated to subsidize diesel for road use, while the remaining 998 million reais are set to subsidize the production and import of oil-based fuels.
